lines.en: Howls through the forest
Licks sharp claws
Bolts toward prey

lines.zh: 我踏碎一根枯枝，声音很响。
lines.en: I snap a dead branch, loud as a shot.
Leaves claw marks in snow
Crunches bones
Sniffs the air
Eats carrion
Releases warning howls
Charges toward village lights

lines.zh: 四爪陷进雪里，一蹬就走。
lines.en: My paws sink in snow, then push off.

lines.zh: 我沿着村庄的篱笆绕圈。
lines.en: I circle along the village fence.
Licks its fur lazily

lines.zh: 针叶林尽头，有围栏和灯。
lines.en: Past the conifers: fences and lights.

lines.zh: 我蹲在村口的石头上，数人。
lines.en: On the village stone, I count the people.
Sharpens its teeth
Limbs stretched, spine arched.
Bites at a branch
Licks a wound
Enjoys solitude
Eats fallen fruit
Mulls over the fight

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，隔着树就闻到。
lines.en: I smell the iron on you through the trees.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我站得比你高。
lines.en: In the pines, I stand taller than you.
Under the moon I'm wolf and worse.

lines.zh: 针叶林里，我的爪子先动。
lines.en: In the pine forest, my claws move first.
Tracks the player's movements
Tastes the player's scent
Glares at the player
Warns the player
Blood still clings to the fur by my mouth.
I lower my body and inch closer.
Howling in pain

lines.zh: 我倒在松针上，爪子还在扒。
lines.en: I fall on pine needles, claws still scraping.
Grunting in pain
Yelping in agony
Yelling in pain

lines.zh: 这一声惨叫，能让整个村子听见。
lines.en: This howl will carry to the whole village.

lines.zh: 我这一声嚎，叫来了整片针叶林。
lines.en: One howl and the whole taiga answers.

lines.zh: 肋骨断了一根，我照样龇牙。
lines.en: A rib is broken; I still bare my teeth.
Howling in agony and falling
The pain cuts my howl in half

lines.zh: 低吼示威，肉块唾手可得。
lines.en: Growl low, meat is within reach.

lines.zh: 村庄的气息，勾起我的兽欲。
lines.en: The village scent stirs my beast's desire.

lines.zh: 猎物就在眼前，饥肠辘辘。
lines.en: The prey is here, my stomach growls.

lines.zh: 月光下，我的獠牙更显锋利。
lines.en: Under the moon, my fangs gleam sharper.
Decaying flesh, my hunger craves.
Come close, be my meal.
The blood's allure is irresistible.

lines.zh: 夜风中，传来猎物的味道。
lines.en: The night breeze carries the prey's scent.

lines.zh: 饥饿的嚎叫，回荡在针叶林。
lines.en: The howl of hunger echoes through the conifer forest.
My prey is only flesh and blood.
Ambush! Your end is here.

lines.zh: 撞击后退，寻找下一个目标。
lines.en: Collide, retreat, find the next target.

lines.zh: 撞飞你，让我品尝你的肉。
lines.en: Knock you down, savor your flesh.

lines.zh: 猛烈撞击，粉碎你的骨骼。
lines.en: Ram with force, shatter your bones.

lines.zh: 冲撞中寻找破绽，一击致命。
lines.en: Find the weakness in the collision, a single hit to kill.

lines.zh: 撞击敌人，粉碎他们的希望。
lines.en: Collide with foes, crush their hope.

lines.zh: 你的身体不够坚硬，撞得粉碎。
lines.en: Your body's not hard enough, it shatters.

lines.zh: 碰撞是战斗的一部分，感受力量。
lines.en: Collision is part of the fight, feel the power.

lines.zh: 用力撞击，直到他们倒下。
lines.en: Collide forcefully until they fall.

lines.zh: 每一次撞击都让他们更接近灭亡。
lines.en: Each collision brings them closer to their demise.
Find the female, procreate.
Battle for the female, it begins.

lines.zh: 雌性的气味，诱惑我交配。
lines.en: The female's scent, it tempts me to mate.

lines.zh: 找到雌性，才能延续血脉。
lines.en: Find the female to continue the bloodline.

lines.zh: 雌性，是我的伴侣和猎物。
lines.en: The female, my mate and prey.

lines.zh: 为了后代，我要战斗到底。
lines.en: For the offspring, I fight to the end.
The female, my life source.

lines.zh: 与雌性交配，确保种族不灭。
lines.en: Mate with the female, ensure the race's survival.

lines.zh: 雌性的声音，唤起我的渴望。
lines.en: The female's voice, it stirs my desire.

lines.zh: 繁衍后代，是狼人的使命。
lines.en: Procreate, it's the werewolf's duty.
Roars, showing sharp fangs.
Locks eyes, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 村里的牲畜，比我的牙软。
lines.en: Village livestock are softer than my teeth.
Howls to claim territory.
Licks wounds to regain strength.
Feasts on beast carrion.
Howls under moonlight.
Tracks prey by scent.
Scratches the ground with claws.
Bites bark to sharpen fangs.
Locks onto prey.
Stares at the village.
Smells fresh blood.

lines.zh: 针叶林的雪，留了我的爪印。
lines.en: My claw marks run through the taiga snow.
Advances toward the village.

lines.zh: 村里飘来的炊烟，我闻见了。
lines.en: I smell the cooking smoke from the village.
Howls a warning.

lines.zh: 你的脚印在雪泥里，很深。
lines.en: Your tracks sink deep in the slush.
Scents prey signs.
Locks onto prey scent.
The humans' firelight is too bright.
I smell sheep in the pines.

lines.zh: 篱笆挡不住跳过去的我。
lines.en: A fence won't stop what can jump it.
The moon is out. I stop hiding.

lines.zh: 你身上的皮革味我记住了。
lines.en: I have your leather scent now.
That window's light should go out.

lines.zh: 我绕到下风口，不让你闻见。
lines.en: I circle downwind so you cannot smell me.
Pounces on you.
Preparing to tear your throat.
Holds tight.
Grasps you with claws.
Attacks your weakness.
Bites you hard.
rips flesh with claws.
Attacks your head.
Pounces on you.

lines.zh: 四条腿把我撑得比你还高。
lines.en: Four legs hold me taller than you.

lines.zh: 你身后就是村口的木墙。
lines.en: Back to the wall, and you are cornered.
My snout is at your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我转到风的下游，闻你更清。
lines.en: I move to your downwind side.

lines.zh: 牙已经露出来，别装看不见。
lines.en: My teeth are bare. Don't pretend not to see.

lines.zh: 你举火把的手抖了一下。
lines.en: Your torch just wavered.

lines.zh: 雪地上的脚印只剩一条。
lines.en: Only one trail is left in the snow.
I stopped howling. That is the bad sign.

lines.zh: 这一扑我扑过很多只羊。
lines.en: I have practiced this pounce many times.

lines.zh: 你身后是栅栏，前面是我。
lines.en: Fence behind you, me in front.
Howling and charging at prey!
It’s stronger at the full moon!
Rip the flesh with its claws!
Roar to scare everything around!
Running fearlessly towards you!
Hunter’s fear its power!
Creeping in the night’s shadow!

lines.zh: 用狼牙咬碎敌人的骨头！
lines.en: Bite through the enemy’s bones!

lines.zh: 它的皮毛在月光下闪亮！
lines.en: Its fur gleams under moonlight!
It’s the ruler of the pine forest!
I hit you from the side and knock you down.
My claws catch the seam of your armor.
I bite your wrist. No sword for you.

lines.zh: 三十点血的野兽不怕疼。
lines.en: A thirty-health beast does not flinch.
I drag you into the trees.
This bite is for your throat.
Even the village dogs have gone silent.

lines.zh: 我的皮毛挡下了你的剑。
lines.en: My hide took your blade.
You fall in the snow and I pin you.
Moonlight makes my bite harder.
It arrives in moonlight!
It hunts at night!
Emerges from the bushes!

lines.zh: 它的脚步声惊醒梦中人！
lines.en: Its footsteps wake the sleeping!
It acts under the dark moon!

lines.zh: 夜晚的针叶林，它是阴影！
lines.en: It’s the shadow in the pine forest at night!
It roams under the moonlight!
Its scent floats in the forest!
It appears in the moonlight!
It’s the hunter in the deep pine forest!

lines.zh: 针叶林里多了一串爪印。
lines.en: A new line of claw marks in the pines.

lines.zh: 我从狼群的边缘走出来。
lines.en: I step out from the edge of the pack.
My fur caught fire and I let out a roar
Fell from a height
Water soaks my fur and I cannot swim.

lines.zh: 炸开的土块砸在我背上。
lines.en: Clods of earth from the blast strike my back.
Hit by an arrow

lines.zh: 魔法烧穿皮肉，狼嚎变了调。
lines.en: The spell burned through. My howl cracked.
Too starved to even howl

lines.zh: 雷声让我想起自己的嚎叫。
lines.en: Thunder sounds like my own howl.
Fall into the void
